## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: validate-feature attaches the diff against the base branch's last green...

The system SHALL ensure that validate-feature attaches the diff against the base branch's last green snapshot to its report.

#### Scenario: validate-feature attaches the diff against the base branch's last green...

WHEN `add-advisory-baseline-diff-gate-with-per-signal-promotion` is implemented
THEN validate-feature attaches the diff against the base branch's last green snapshot to its report.

### Requirement: A seeded change that doubles an RPC count with all tests green is flagged by...

The system SHALL ensure that a seeded change that doubles an RPC count with all tests green is flagged by the gate.

#### Scenario: A seeded change that doubles an RPC count with all tests green is flagged by...

WHEN `add-advisory-baseline-diff-gate-with-per-signal-promotion` is implemented
THEN A seeded change that doubles an RPC count with all tests green is flagged by the gate.

### Requirement: Each signal has a recorded mode (advisory/blocking) and a measured...

The system SHALL ensure that each signal has a recorded mode (advisory/blocking) and a measured false-positive rate, and setting a signal to blocking without a recorded rate is rejected.

#### Scenario: Each signal has a recorded mode (advisory/blocking) and a measured...

WHEN `add-advisory-baseline-diff-gate-with-per-signal-promotion` is implemented
THEN Each signal has a recorded mode (advisory/blocking) and a measured false-positive rate, and setting a signal to blocking without a recorded rate is rejected.
